name: Acid techno
key_tendency: A or E minor; the 303 line jumps octaves on the root with a few scale tones.
signature: Sawtooth 303-style line with high resonance (lpq 12 to 20)
The filter cutoff is the instrument: sweep it with a slow sine or perlin
Octave jumps and accents carry the riff
Pounding 909 kick, open hats, distortion via shape
Long builds that only move the filter
listen_for: The same 16 notes play for minutes while the filter and resonance turn the line from a burble into a scream. Listen for the squelch peaking every 8 bars.

starter.arrange:
arrange(
  [8, stack(drums, acid.lpf(500))],
  [16, stack(drums, bass, acid)],
  [16, stack(drums, bass, acid.lpq(20).delay(0.3).delaytime(0.33))],
  [8, stack(acid, fx)],
  [8, stack(drums, bass)],
)
